review.notes: Full review. Sources: none of the six cited books could be read legally, so the seeded sample (0.1-3.4, 5.1) was not checked against the texts; all are listed under Not verifiable. Adversarial pass: every identity and every numerical Check of Layers 0-5 recomputed independently (group laws, cocycles, Gamma and Whittaker kernels, Hermite/Laguerre/Charlier matrix elements, Bargmann intertwining, oscillator and Miller matrix elements); all agree with the text. Findings: 1.3 restates SpecialFunctionsHypergeometric 6.3 on main (R01); the Fock space and Bargmann transform are also owned by ThetaKernelsForUnitaryDualPairs 3.45, open pull request 2907 (R02); the kernel composition law of 2.6 has no hypotheses and its stated derivation does not cover its use (R03). Checks: dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with 48 sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe closes 4 of 48 statements; supplier citations resolved on main and at the open heads; pinned library declarations opened. Two automatic checks set aside (choice in the copied supplier definition of the multiplier representation; the heading over the library #check block).
